Opposite Party
 Coram: Hon'Ble Mr. Justice Rajesh Shankar

-----
For the Petitioner : Mr. Manish Kumar, Advocate For the State : Mr. Shekhar Sinha, A.P.P.
-----
07/16.04.2019

The present petition has been filed for quashing the entire criminal proceeding including the order dated 09.06.2010 passed by the learned Chief Judicial Magistrate, Pakur in connection with O.C.R. No. 41 of 2010, corresponding to T.R. No. 974 of 2010, whereby cognizance of the offence under Section 16(1)(a)(i) of the prevention of Food Adulteration Act, 1954 has been taken against the petitioner.

On perusal of the report submitted by the learned Sub-Divisional Judicial Magistrate, Pakur, vide letter no. 133 dated 16.03.2019, it appears that O.C.R. No. 41 of 2010, corresponding to T.R. No. 974 of 2010 has been disposed of by the concerned court below, wherein accused Deepak Kumar Bhagat @ Dipak Kumar Bhagat (the petitioner herein) and Dev Narayan Bhagat have been acquitted of the charges levelled against them.

entities.text: Deepak Kumar Bhagat @ Dipak Kumar Bhagat
entities.label: PETITIONER

sentences.text: In view of the said development, there is no need to further proceed in the matter.
The present Cr.M.P. is accordingly disposed of.
(Rajesh Shankar, J.) Manish Deepak Kumar Bhagat @ Dipak Kumar Bhagat vs The State Of Jharkhand ... ...
